verdict.rationale: Cekura stores customer call transcripts and recordings as CallLogs, so retention and deletion controls are a fair axis. The only related evidence is a PII-redaction feature that automatically removes sensitive information from transcripts and audio, plus a CLI described as able to 'manage' call data. Neither documents configurable retention periods or explicit deletion. Missing for 10: configurable data-retention policies, documented call-log/recording deletion via API, CLI or UI, account-level data purge, and independent corroboration.
